name: usage-line
description: Status line with a traffic light per limit: 5h, weekly, compaction, spend, prompt cache, plus skills and memory loaded

amberPct.title: Amber at (% of a rate limit)
amberPct.description: 5h, weekly and gateway spend limits turn amber at this share used

redPct.title: Red at (% of a rate limit)
redPct.description: 5h, weekly and gateway spend limits turn red at this share used

compactAmberPct.title: Amber at (% to auto-compact)
compactAmberPct.description: The light turns amber when the conversation is this close to auto-compaction

compactRedPct.title: Red at (% to auto-compact)
compactRedPct.description: The light turns red when the conversation is this close to auto-compaction

dailyBudgetUsd.title: Daily budget (USD, API only)
dailyBudgetUsd.description: Pay-per-token sessions: amber at 70%, red at 90% of this across today's sessions. Leave empty to just show spend

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: off: never; once: one toast per limit, window and level; every: each time a limit gets worse

cacheTtlMin.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMin.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after a response; the line counts down to it. 5 is the API default; use 60 if your sessions get the 1-hour cache
